sources.text:
* * *

Whether chalk coast or „Rasender Roland“ (“Racing Roland”), whether resort architecture or red brick Gothic: Rügen is as multifaceted as it is appealing. Here you find suitable suggestions for your excursions to the sights of the island of Rügen.

[![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/Mediendatenbank/2015-10-25_399_Binz.jpg)\\
\\
**Ostseebad Binz** \\
\\
Rügen´s largest seaside resort.](https://en.ostseebad-binz.de/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/4/d/csm_Strand_Sellin_CT_Kopie_02cfffdeed.jpg)\\
\\
**Ostseebad Sellin** \\
\\
Popular seaside resort with famous pier.](https://www.ostseebad-sellin.de/en/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Goehren_2.png)\\
\\
**Ostseebad Göhren** \\
\\
Seaside and hydrotherapy resort on Rügen island](http://www.goehren-ruegen.de/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/2/9/csm_11-Strand-Baabe-Boote_8ee48b374b.jpg)\\
\\
**Ostseebad Baabe** \\
\\
Seaside resort at the edge of the Baltic sea.](https://www.baabe.de/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/b/0/csm_Mole_Sassnitz_Abends_3_d6eb9ad5ba.jpg)\\
\\
**Sassnitz** \\
\\
Old fishing village with a lovely old town.](https://www.sassnitz.de/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/b/e/csm_45-Suedruegen-Putbus-9_8740600a80.jpg)\\
\\
**Putbus** \\
\\
Founded in 1810 by Prince Wilhelm Malte zu Putbus as his town of residence - built in the Classicist style.](http://putbus.de/index2.html) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/e/7/csm_122-NPZ-Koenigsstuhl-4_5f3220e1c8.jpg)\\
\\
**Nationalpark-Zentrum KÖNIGSSTUHL** \\
\\
Visit Rügen\`s most famous landmark as well as the exhibition center.](https://www.koenigsstuhl.com/en/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/0/b/csm_128-Jagdschloss-Granitz-2_44e6fdc3cf.jpg)\\
\\
**Hunting lodge Granitz** \\
\\
Hunting lodge built between 1837 and 1846.](https://www.mv-schloesser.de/location/schloss-granitz/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/d/9/csm_121-NEZR-1_8568a3fa9a.jpg)\\
\\
**Naturerbe Zentrum Rügen** \\
\\
Tree-top path and exhibition center.](https://www.nezr.de/nezr-en/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/0/5/csm_123-Kap-Arkona-6_ebabb6d682.jpg)\\
\\
**Cape Arkona** \\
\\
Light houses, tracking tower and most north-eastern point.](http://www.kap-arkona.de/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/6/e/csm_125-Rasender-Roland-1_63d4fe83bd.jpg)\\
\\
**Rasender Roland** \\
\\
Racing Roland, a historic narrow gauge train.](http://ruegensche-baederbahn.de/home.html) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/0/3/csm_32-Hiddensee-1_bc6c178867.jpg)\\
\\
**Island Hiddensee** \\
\\
Sister island of Rügen.](https://www.seebad-hiddensee.de/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/7/5/csm_1292-Baederarchitektur-3_7ea6639496.jpg)\\
\\
**Resort architecture** \\
\\
White villas all across the coastline.](https://www.ruegen.de/en/things-to-do/experiences/arts-culture/resort-architecture) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/3/2/csm_1295-Backsteingotik-6_b18e1aa137.jpg)\\
\\
**Brick Gothic style**](http://www.eurob.org/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/0/0/csm_129-KdF-Bad-Prora-3_49432beed5.jpg)\\
\\
**Prora** \\
\\
The “KdF sea bath for 20000”](http://www.proradok.de/en/startseite-2/) [![](https://www.ruegen.de/fileadmin/_processed_/4/7/csm_Binz_Muether_ae72a650d3.png)\\
\\
**Müther Buildings** \\
\\
Concrete shell constructions built by Ulrich Müther.](https://www.ruegen.de/en/things-to-do/experiences/arts-culture/muether-buildings)
